custody_model: Non-custodial smart-contract lending. Euler V1 pooled lending positions through protocol contracts; Euler V2 was rebuilt around modular vault and connector infrastructure for permissionless lending markets.
yield_source: Interest paid by borrowers using on-chain lending markets and vaults.
risk_notes: Smart-contract and market-design risk can cause severe losses or protocol-wide impairment. The March 2023 V1 exploit demonstrates that code-level vulnerabilities can affect otherwise overcollateralized lending positions; the later V2 architecture should be treated as a rebuilt successor rather than evidence that V1 risk was unchanged.
